The institutional investor held 16,900 shares of the television services company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $874,000, up from 5,600 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Capital Management Associates who had been investing in Amc Networks Inc (A) for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $3.29 billion market cap company.
